result.note: Tests the review of the 2011 India–Japan trade agreement, the size of the deficit and the shift in India's approach.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, India began reviewing its 2011 trade agreement with Japan. Consider the following statements:
items: Through the review, India is shifting its focus from attracting Japanese investment towards expanding goods exports to Japan.
India's bilateral trade deficit with Japan nearly tripled to USD 15.4 billion in a decade.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 reverses the story. India is pivoting away from selling goods and towards courting Japanese capital. The review was prompted by the bilateral deficit nearly tripling to USD 15.4 billion over a decade.
questions.source: India is reviewing its 2011 trade agreement with Japan after the bilateral deficit nearly tripled to USD 15.4 billion in a decade, pivoting from selling goods to courting Japanese capital.
